decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.0456. Series context: trend strength 0.9995 and seasonal strength 0.0802; model ranking is stable across windows (Kendall tau 0.727); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 78.378.
